user: Thanks. How does the review process work in general?
answer:
What I did
- Opened the dispute for TX-0401 and escalated the case to a human agent for review.

What I found in our process guidance
- Timeline targets: 10 business days for card reason codes and 20 business days for transfer reason codes. Complex cases involving a foreign acquirer can run to 45 calendar days; we notify you if that happens.
- Provisional credit: only applied where the dispute is for a fraud reason code and the disputed amount exceeds EUR 50; it is applied within two business days and is reversed if the dispute is later declined.
- You may withdraw a dispute at any time before resolution; withdrawal is final and the same transaction cannot be disputed again under the same reason code.

What happens next for your case
- The dispute will be reviewed according to the applicable timeline (you’ll be notified if the case becomes complex).
- If any additional information is needed, a human agent will contact you via the email registered to your account.
- You may withdraw the dispute before resolution if you choose; tell me if you want to do that.

If you want, I can send a statement or supporting documents for ACC-1005 to your registered email to help the review. Tell me the period you need.

Dispute handling process
## Provisional credit
Where the disputed amount exceeds EUR 50 and the reason code is a fraud code, a
provisional credit is applied within two business days. Provisional credit is
reversed if the dispute is later declined.

Glossary
## Provisional credit
A temporary refund applied while a dispute is reviewed; reversed if the dispute
is declined.

Dispute handling process
## Review timelines
The review target is 10 business days for card reason codes and 20 business
days for transfer reason codes. Complex cases involving a foreign acquirer may
run to 45 calendar days; the customer is notified when that happens.

Dispute handling process
## Withdrawing a dispute
A customer may withdraw a dispute at any time before resolution. Withdrawal is
final; the same transaction cannot be disputed again under the same reason code.
